user.title: Pantry
user.description: Set up the household inventory. It appears as "Vorrat" in the sidebar.

unit_is_default.message: This unit (or one defined on it) is the default unit. Change the default under Settings › Defaults first.

shopping_unknown.message: “{name}” is neither a product nor a category. Add new ones in the Pantry panel under Einkauf.

location_has_stock.message: The location still holds stock. Move or take it out first.

not_loaded.message: The pantry integration is not loaded.

in_use.message: The entry is still in use and cannot be deleted.

duplicate.message: An entry with this name already exists.

invalid_unit.message: Invalid unit: the factor must be greater than 0 and a base unit cannot have a base unit itself.

invalid_parent.message: A category cannot be moved into itself or one of its subcategories.

recipe_unreachable.message: The page could not be loaded.

recipe_not_found.message: No recipe found on this page (schema.org recipe data is needed).

off_unavailable.message: Open Food Facts is not reachable. Please try again later.

product_unknown.message: No product with barcode {code}. Book new products in once in the Pantry panel.

no_label_printer.message: No label printer is configured (Settings › Devices & services › Pantry › Configure).

no_receipt_printer.message: No receipt printer is configured (Settings › Devices & services › Pantry › Configure › Receipt printer).

nothing_to_print.message: The shopping list has no open items to print.

not_food.message: This category is not a food and cannot be a recipe ingredient.

init.title: Settings
init.description: What do you want to set up?

label.title: Label printer settings
label.description: Host, label size and printing for the chosen label printer.

data_description.label_printer_host: Network: address of the print server (port {port} if you give only the host). USB on the Home Assistant host: the device path, e.g. /dev/usb/lp0 (in Docker, pass it with devices:).
data_description.test_print: Sends one test label to the printer when you save.

data_description.household_servings: Servings the household cooks by default.

receipt.title: Receipt printer
receipt.description: ESC/POS receipt printer for the shopping list. Leave the printer empty for none.

data.receipt_cut: Cut the paper at the end

data_description.receipt_printer: USB on the Home Assistant host: the device path, e.g. /dev/usb/lp0 (USB printer) or /dev/ttyUSB0 (USB-serial) (in Docker, pass it with devices:). Network printer: host or host:port (port 9100 if only the host is given).
data_description.receipt_baud: Only for a device path of a serial / USB-serial printer; ignored for network printers. Use the printer's setting (often 9600 or 115200).
data_description.test_print: Sends one short test receipt to the printer when you save.

book_in.name: Book in
book_in.description: Book packages of a known product in by its barcode. Returns batch_id (for print_labels).

code.name: Barcode
code.description: EAN of a product already in the pantry.

expires_on.name: Expiry date
expires_on.description: Best-before / use-by date; empty for products without one.

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Name of the location; empty = the product's default location.

book_out.name: Book out
book_out.description: Take packages out by barcode (earliest expiry first) or by a scanned label code (PTRY:…, one package of that batch).

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Only from this location (not with a label code).

print_labels.name: Print labels
print_labels.description: Print labels of a batch on the label printer.

print_shopping_list.name: Print shopping list
print_shopping_list.description: Print the open shopping list items on the receipt printer.

options.browser: No printer - print via the browser
options.dymo_lw4xx: Dymo LabelWriter 450 / 4xx (network via a USB print server, port 9100, or USB)
